query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM reminders
        WHERE owner_id = $1
          AND ($2::text IS NULL OR room_id = $2)
          AND (
            ($3 = 'pending' AND status = 'pending') OR
            ($3 = 'history' AND status != 'pending') OR
            ($3 = 'all') OR
            ($3 = 'triggered' AND status = 'triggered') OR
            ($3 = 'cancelled' AND status = 'cancelled') OR
            ($3 = 'failed' AND status = 'failed') OR
            (status = $3)
          )
